name: Akitakata (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Akitakata city emblem in green and blue: a green curved stroke above a blue stylised figure with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Akitakata, a city in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 March 2004.

features.role: Akitakata city emblem — a green curved stroke above a blue stylised figure with a disc
